This seems plausible. ORF3a protein of SARS-CoV-2 is known to induce apoptosis. There is literature that ORF3a activates caspase-8 and induces extrinsic apoptosis. It also does not affect Bcl-2 levels, suggesting it's not through the intrinsic mitochondrial pathway. So (B) appears correct.
